issue.title: test_default_pipe_creates_family_member_with_fork_and_shared_workspace fails under the full parallel lane, passes on isolated rerun
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/fakey/test_pipe_e2e.py::test_default_pipe_creates_family_member_with_fork_and_shared_workspace`
- **Repro:** `just check` (escalated to the full parallel lane)

PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-qt.4 (epic sase-qt, "ACE Memory panel for browsing
and editing SASE memory notes"), routed here by that epic's land agent.

OBSERVED: the node failed once inside a full-suite `just check` run on
2026-08-19 (34045 passed in that run) and passed when rerun individually on the
same tree. The phase's diff was the Memory panel shell
(`src/sase/ace/tui/modals/memory_panel*.py`, `styles.tcss`, the modal export
table) and its tests -- it touches nothing in `sase pipe`, family creation,
forking, or workspace sharing, so the phase did not cause this.

NOT YET CORROBORATED: this is a single sighting from one workspace. The node is
NOT in `tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt`, so `tools/selection_health
--fail-on-new-flake` will treat a second sighting as a new flake and turn
`check-full` red. Whoever picks this up should first confirm it reproduces at
all before chasing a mechanism -- and per that file's header, add a baseline
entry naming this bead only after there is real repeat evidence.

RELEVANT CONTEXT: `tests/fakey/test_pipe_e2e.py` was last touched by
a64acb267 "feat(monitor)!: require start and stop status flags on monitor
start", which landed 2026-08-19, shortly before this sighting; that commit
changed monitor start's required flags and is worth ruling in or out. The test
creates a real family member with a fork and a shared workspace, so it is
sensitive to workspace-claim contention -- see sase-lb (allocator hands a
`sase_<N>` clone to a second agent while another is still RUNNING) and sase-qa
(a RUNNING claim row with an unrecognized trailing part is silently dropped).

SCOPE: determine whether the failure is a real race in the pipe/family/workspace
path or lane contention, then either fix it or record it in the flake baseline
under this bead with the evidence the header requires.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once during a full-suite `just check` run on 2026-08-19 (34045 passed in that run) at epic sase-qt phase 4, then passed on an isolated rerun of the same tree. Fail rate 1/2 observed; parallel-lane only, not reproduced serially. Single workspace (sase-org/sase workspace running sase-qt.4), single head. Not present in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt, so a second sighting will trip tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-oz — another parallel-lane-only ACE/Textual flake proposed by the same epic (sase-qt); its description records the useful negative evidence (alone, whole-module, and test-contention lanes all green) that a whole-suite-only flake needs cross-file reproduction, not a single-file soak.
